title: TradeIntent
description: One client-armed pick handed to the broker-manager. Generated from broker_contract.trade_intent.schema — edit the dataclasses, never this file. The schema pins SHAPE; a schema-valid document can still be refused by the door's semantic rules (see intent_invalid in the package README). Within a major version only optional fields are added: a field is never renamed, retyped, or given a new unit. NOTE: no gate reads schema_version today — it is stamped and carried, and a document declaring any version decodes, so treat it as provenance rather than as version negotiation.

instrument.description: What is being traded, and where.

spec.description: The unsized trade: entry ladder, stop, TP ladder, size.

meta.description: Provenance and identity of this document.

exit.description: Optional exit geometry: the levels to place, and how the stop is managed afterwards. Null when the source brief yields no buildable bracket.

account_id.description: Reserved tenant dimension; one value today.

mic.description: ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code, e.g. "XNYS". WHICH venues a deployment can actually trade is the adapter's knowledge, not this contract's (#1122).

entry_tiers.description: The entry ladder, rung by rung.

disaster_stop.description: Stop price in the instrument's currency; sits below every entry rung.

tp_tranches.description: The take-profit ladder. Empty is the legitimate --no-tp shape: a pick that runs to its disaster stop.

suggested_size_pct.description: PERCENTAGE of account equity, 0-100 — not a fraction.

order_ttl_days.description: Entry-order lifetime in TRADING days (XNYS), not calendar days. 0 is the planner's "field absent" sentinel and resolves to the default downstream.

side.description: Only long entries are armed today. Pinned to one literal as a barrier against the client-side "Sell"->Buy footgun rather than left open.

schema_version.description: Wire version of this spec. The same constant as meta.schema_version, not an independent dial.

limit_price.description: Price in the instrument's currency. For an immediate tier this is the operator's CAP (the worst acceptable fill), not a pullback level.

alloc_pct.description: PERCENTAGE of the pick's notional, 0-100 — not a fraction. The rungs sum to 100.

tag.description: Free-text rung label, e.g. "T1". No sizing semantics.

entry_mode.description: "pullback" rests below the market; "immediate" is an arm-manual now tranche.

price.description: Take-profit price in the instrument's currency.

tranche_pct.description: PERCENTAGE of the position, 0-100 — not a fraction. The ladder MAY sum to less than 100: that is a deliberate runner, not an error.

r_multiple.description: Label only: the tranche's distance in R (multiples of initial risk). No sizing semantics.

tag.description: Free-text tranche label, e.g. "TP1". No sizing semantics.

armed_ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the moment the pick was armed.

trade_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Date key of the record — pick identity, TTL anchor, reconcile join. For a manual pick (no brief row) this is the arm date; provenance lives in `source`, not in this field's name (#1252).

schema_version.description: Wire version of the document. A consumer reads this one.

source.description: Where the intent came from: "brief" (parsed from a brief row by `broker arm`) or "manual" (operator-provided levels via `broker arm-manual`, #1235). Journals and later measurement separate the two populations on this marker; legacy payloads without the key decode to "brief".

generation.description: Same-day re-arm counter, 1-based (#1371). Pick identity everywhere downstream — queue fold, submissions join, entry-watch crids, stop refs — is (ticker, trade_date, generation), and the queue keeps the LATEST, so a resubmission REPLACES rather than duplicates.

initial_levels.description: Levels to PLACE, or null when the document supplies none.

reaction_plan.description: How the stop MOVES after fill. An empty plan means the stop is never moved. The door accepts at most ONE stop-management primitive and refuses a second with reaction_plan_ambiguous — that rule lives in validate_intent, not in this document's shape.

stop.description: Stop price to place, in the instrument's currency.

tp.description: Take-profit price to place, in the instrument's currency.

k_atr.description: ATR multiple the re-anchored stop sits away from the fill price.

atr.description: Absolute ATR snapshot — a distance in the instrument's currency, not a multiple — so the executor recomputes the levels without a second fetch.

ceiling_price.description: Caps the TAKE-PROFIT (tp = min(tp, ceiling_price)); it never touches the stop. The door refuses a non-null value today: ceiling_price_unsupported.

arm_trigger_r.description: Favourable excursion, in R (multiples of initial risk), at which the trail arms.

trail_frac.description: FRACTION in (0, 1] of the peak excursion the stop gives back — a fraction here, unlike the _pct fields elsewhere in this contract.

kind.description: Discriminator of the reaction-plan union; reserves the tag and nothing else.
